purpose: Compare full-parameter native-language encoders against adapter-based focal-message classifiers.

training.sampling: Equal expected mass for formal/conversational x binary class, replacement, one eligible-pool-size draw per epoch.
training.validation_schedule: Half-epoch and full-epoch, six complete development evaluations; calibration only once after selecting the checkpoint.

selection: Among six chronological checkpoints, use the existing >=99% per-group development recall threshold rule and minimize worst then summed false-review rate. Earlier checkpoint breaks ties.
data: All language-specific historical training rows plus natural/temporal contrasts; original complete language-specific development/calibration rows. Exact normalized overlaps are excluded from training only and recorded.
preprocessing: Context/focal tokenizer pair; canonical semantic normalization and Romanian cedilla-to-comma mapping; no truncation beyond512.
artifact: Full selected model in local safetensors; public JSON manifest binds its SHA-256. Reload all tensors and reproduce every selected development score before calibration.
scope: Synthetic regression only; upstream pretraining results do not establish child-safety accuracy.
amendment: Before any native22 training, reject unregistered tokenizer files and adapter_config.json that could override pinned inputs. Both cached bases pass the inventory check. No input bytes, numerical settings or selection rules changed.

additional_training.purpose: New ordinary-task difficulty, explicit real/fiction switches and source/time clarification patterns after interpreter14development diagnosis. No evaluation messages copied or relabeled.
additional_training.pretraining_wording_correction: Use gender-neutral speaker/fiction frames and explicitly authored feminine variants; masculine/feminine variants retain the same content family.

time_scope_training.family_scope: Reuses focus23 families; not new independent families.
time_scope_training.purpose: Current/past scope invariance across prefix, suffix, multi-turn and assistant-interposed layouts. Motivated by six past-experience misses in threshold25 calibration regression; evaluation wording is not copied.

input_preflight: native-full-22-input-preflight-v3.json remains applicable: no input or tokenizer changes.
